mfg1-surface-lesson-053.sourceJa: 右ねじの関係を視点と量で区別する。直線導体の電流が紙面から手前へ出ると磁界は反時計回り。コイルを端面から見て電流が反時計回りなら内部磁界は手前へ向かう。
mfg1-surface-lesson-053.text: Distinguish the right-hand screw relationship by viewpoint and quantity. If current in a straight conductor comes out of the page toward you, the magnetic field is counterclockwise. Viewed from a coil end, counterclockwise current gives an internal field toward you.

mfg1-surface-lesson-060.sourceJa: めっき皮膜の断面例。ピンホールは皮膜を貫く穴、ここでのピットは途中までのくぼみ、ふくれは皮膜の局部的な浮き。模式図であり、寸法と合否基準は適用規格・限度見本で確認する。
mfg1-surface-lesson-060.text: Example coating cross-sections: a pinhole passes through the coating; a pit here stops partway through; a blister is a local lifting of the coating. These are schematics. Check dimensions and acceptance criteria against applicable standards and limit samples.
